speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Prolactin level.

I need to confirm if you are experiencing an overwhelming urge to move or if your legs feel like they are "creepy-crawley" inside, which would suggest akathisia rather than a different condition like pneumonia.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Prolactin: Elevated (consistent with risperidone therapy)

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated prolactin confirms risperidone is affecting your endocrine system, but the restless pacing and fidgeting you described earlier are classic signs of drug-induced akathisia. Have you noticed any worsening of these inner urges or an inability to sit still during your daily activities?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Recently diagnosed with schizophrenia. No other significant past medical history. Social history: College student, lives with parents. Denies tobacco, alcohol, or drug use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Akathisia.

The clinical picture of persistent inner restlessness, inability to sit still, and repetitive leg movements starting two months after initiating risperidone, combined with your denial of other substance use, strongly supports this diagnosis. No further tests are required; we will proceed with adjusting your medication or adding an antidopaminergic agent.
